note: P(plays next team game | has missed k straight), top-150 players 2021-24 (research/hazard_refit.py). Each player's last stint runs to his team's final game, so absences that never ended (season-ending injuries) are included as censored; absences with a coach's-decision, rest, personal or suspension entry are excluded. Inactive rest days can't be separated from injuries in box scores, so k=1-2 still include some rest.

designation._source: isheplayingtonight.com: first official-report designation vs played, 2,007 player-games, Jan-Oct 2026

healthy_curve._source: 2021-24 box-score panel, top-100 players: P(plays a non-b2b team game N games after a game he played); n=16,500 at N=1

_b2b_source: same panel: b2b/non-b2b play-rate ratio 0.931-0.943 at every horizon (research/out2.txt: miss 13.9% -> 19.8%, 0.802/0.861)
